tasks.title: Handle WebGL context loss and free contexts on destroy
tasks.objective: A lost WebGL context is reported to the user and the viewer is rebuilt when the context returns
tasks.estimate_rationale: No context-loss handling exists today; WEBGL_lose_context lets the test force it, timing of restore is uncertain.

complexity.justification: Context loss interacts with renderer disposal, shadow maps and the measurement registry

scope.justification: Listeners on the canvas, a message state and forceContextLoss in destroy

duration.justification: Ninety minutes including a forced-loss case in the re-entry suite

risk.justification: A wrong rebuild could leak GPU memory or double-mount the viewer on phones

coupling.justification: Edits the same viewer lifecycle as T2 right after it

evidence: assumption:mobile browsers drop contexts under memory pressure
confidence.justification: Library and captures create extra contexts, but loss frequency in the field is unmeasured

acceptance_criteria: webglcontextlost shows a recoverable message instead of a frozen canvas
webglcontextrestored or a retry rebuilds the viewer and frames the scene
destruir releases the context so repeated visits do not pile up contexts
After forcing context loss from the dev console the Taller shows a retry message and rebuilds the scene

verification.purpose: webglcontextlost shows a recoverable message instead of a frozen canvas
webglcontextrestored or a retry rebuilds the viewer and frames the scene
destruir releases the context so repeated visits do not pile up contexts
